name: Suzuri Shodo
description: A quiet, vertical-type education theme for a small calligraphy (shodo) school in an old timber house with a moss-garden veranda. Washi, felt grey and sumi ink, with a muted seal red used only for small marks (the active menu numeral, the free trial slot, today's timetable marker and the stopping dot after vertical titles). The wordmark sits top-left in Sawarabi Mincho; on the home page the menu is a numbered list with hairline leaders in the hero's lower-right corner, on inner pages a compact numbered row top-right. The home page is a sequence of chapters with long pauses: the hero brush-stroke photograph as a wide pale sheet with the school's idea set vertically, four chapters (ink, brush, paper, the stroke) each with one photograph, a vertical title and a short paragraph on alternating sides, the five class levels as tall vertical columns read right to left like hanging scrolls (weekly hours and monthly fees), a note from the teacher, the free trial lesson and the journal. The footer is the weekly class timetable drawn as a folded practice sheet on felt grey, with today marked from the site's timezone, beside the school details. With Classes, Timetable, Materials (the starter kit with prices and care notes), About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact (a trial-lesson enquiry that composes an email, no backend). The school details, the timetable and the class levels are synced patterns, edited once. Sawarabi Mincho over Zen Kaku Gothic Antique. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: none for the header, footer and layout codes (H12 / F11 / L5 as planned). Added colours: stone #5E5852 for secondary text (6.2:1 on washi, 5.1:1 on felt) and four ink tones (heavy #3D3935, mid #6E6862, pale #A39C94, dry #CDC6BB) for the five-tones-of-ink marks and the timetable legend only (marks, never text).
